title: What actually happens when you make a call to an LLM?

cues.en: Congratulations on getting through three of the four major concepts of LLM.
cues.zh: 恭喜，你已經完成 LLM 四大概念中的三個。

cues.en: So we have gone through chat, tools, and structured output.
cues.zh: 我們已經介紹對話、工具和結構化輸出。

cues.en: We're still missing RAG, but before we go there, I want to do a little intermission of the life of an LLM call, meaning
cues.zh: 還剩下 RAG，不過在那之前，我想先插入一段 LLM 呼叫的生命週期，也就是

cues.en: what actually goes on when you call the LLM, what requests and what response are going on.
cues.zh: 呼叫 LLM 時，實際發送哪些請求、收到哪些回應。

cues.en: The reason why I've waited for this moment is that we need to know about tools and structured output in order to understand this
cues.zh: 等到現在才介紹，是因為必須先理解工具和結構化輸出，才能看懂這堂

cues.en: lecture.
cues.zh: 課。

cues.en: And we now have that, so now is the time to do this.
cues.zh: 現在已經有這些基礎，正是介紹的時候。

cues.en: I will do this through slides here, but the code is also in the sample repo.
cues.zh: 我會透過投影片說明，程式碼也放在範例儲存庫。

cues.en: So what we see here is that we have a normal system and there should be nothing new except this little line that enables
cues.zh: 這裡是一般的程式設定，沒有新內容，除了這一行，能讓

cues.en: us to get the raw calls back and forth.
cues.zh: 我們取得來回傳送的原始呼叫。

cues.en: There will be a bonus video just after this explaining a bit more what's going on, because there's a bit more before this and after this in order to do this.
cues.zh: 這段之後會有補充影片，說明更多設定細節，因為這一行前後還要做一些準備。

cues.en: But for us, it's just a normal client and a normal agent.
cues.zh: 目前先看成一般用戶端和一般代理程式。

cues.en: We are giving it one tool called getWeather, which is just down here.
cues.zh: 我們提供一個 getWeather 工具，實作就在下面，

cues.en: We tell it to speak like a pirate as an instruction.
cues.zh: 並在指示中要求使用海盜口吻說話。

cues.en: We make a message called, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 使用者訊息是「巴黎的天氣如何？」。

cues.en: And we want it back as a weather response, meaning structured output.
cues.zh: 希望回傳 WeatherResponse，也就是結構化輸出。

cues.en: So nothing new that we haven't learned over the last couple of sections.
cues.zh: 這些都是過去幾章已經學過的內容。

cues.en: And this is what happens when we call this specific line of code.
cues.zh: 接下來看看，呼叫這一行時究竟發生什麼。

cues.en: So we call this URL, and in my case, I had my resource called sensum365ai, but yours will be something else here.
cues.zh: 程式會呼叫這個網址。我的 Azure 資源名是 sensum365ai，你的名稱會不同。

cues.en: But beyond that, we're just calling OpenAI's deployments of chat-gpg5 in the chat system on completions with a version number.
cues.zh: 其餘就是呼叫 OpenAI 部署的 GPT-5，透過 Chat Completions 介面，並指定 API 版本。

cues.en: And then we sent the first thing we sent.
cues.zh: 接著看看第一次送出的內容。

cues.en: In general, you should look like these three sections are one long JSON file.
cues.zh: 你可以把這三個區塊視為一份長長的 JSON，

cues.en: I just put it up in three columns here, so it's easier to look at.
cues.zh: 我只是分成三欄，方便閱讀。

cues.en: But the message, we sent two messages and not just one.
cues.zh: 在 Messages 裡，其實送出了兩則訊息，而不是一則。

cues.en: And that's because, of course, we have our instructions, which is the system message.
cues.zh: 原因當然是指示會變成 System 訊息，

cues.en: So this is turned into one message.
cues.zh: 所以這段會轉成一則訊息，

cues.en: This is turned into another message.
cues.zh: 使用者的問題則是另一則，

cues.en: And that's why we have two messages here, one in the role of system and one in the role of user.
cues.zh: 因此有兩則訊息，一個角色是 System，另一個是 User。

cues.en: We then send the gpt5 as the model, and then we send this block of code.
cues.zh: 接著模型設成 GPT-5，再送出這一塊資料。

cues.en: This block of code is the JSON schema for our weather response, meaning this object over here.
cues.zh: 這一塊是 WeatherResponse 的 JSON Schema，也就是這邊的物件，

cues.en: So we know that it's a weather response.
cues.zh: 因此知道它是一個天氣回應。

cues.en: We know that we have a city of type string, a condition of type string, a degrees of type integer, and a degrees Celsius
cues.zh: 裡面有字串型別的 City、字串型別的 Condition，以及整數型別的華氏溫度和攝氏溫度，

cues.en: of type integer.
cues.zh: 這些溫度欄位都是整數。

cues.en: We know that these four of them are required, which is what we see over here.
cues.zh: 也知道四個欄位都是必填，對應這裡的設定。

cues.en: And then a bit more like additional properties, which we have none and so on.
cues.zh: 還有 AdditionalProperties 等設定，這裡不允許額外欄位。

cues.en: So this is also being sent along with the messages.
cues.zh: 這些資訊也會和訊息一起送出。

cues.en: And then the final thing we send is our tool, which is down here, and turned into a schema.
cues.zh: 最後送出的是工具，也就是下面這個方法，會被轉成 Schema。

cues.en: That is a function.
cues.zh: 它是一個 Function。

cues.en: The function has no description, because it didn't provide one.
cues.zh: 因為沒有提供，所以這個函式沒有 Description。

cues.en: The name of getWeather.
cues.zh: 名稱是 getWeather。

cues.en: It had one parameter, which was called city, and that city was of type string.
cues.zh: 它有一個參數 city，型別是 string。

cues.en: And that is what's being sent.
cues.zh: 這就是送出的內容。

cues.en: And then you might think, oh, then it will tell us back it's sunny and 90 degrees.
cues.zh: 你可能會想：接下來它應該回覆晴天、90 度。

cues.en: But that's not what happens.
cues.zh: 但實際上不是這樣。

cues.en: What happens is it gives us back this response.
cues.zh: 它會先回傳這個回應。

cues.en: And in this response, we are getting back a finishing reason of tool calls.
cues.zh: 其中的 Finish Reason 是 tool_calls，

cues.en: And that means it says, hey, I want you to make a tool call.
cues.zh: 意思是：「我希望你去呼叫工具。」

cues.en: And in our case, it says, I want you to call getWeather, and I want you to give the parameter city the value of Paris.
cues.zh: 在這個例子，它說：「請呼叫 getWeather，並把 city 參數設為 Paris。」

cues.en: Beyond that, there's a few small things here that are mostly empty in our case.
cues.zh: 另外還有一些欄位，這裡大部分是空的。

cues.en: There's some creation date.
cues.zh: 例如建立日期、

cues.en: There's some ID.
cues.zh: ID、

cues.en: There's what model and what its date is.
cues.zh: 使用的模型，以及模型日期。

cues.en: It gives us back some information about hate speech, jailbreak, and so on, if any of this is violating that, which it's not.
cues.zh: 也回傳仇恨言論、越獄等內容檢查資訊，判斷是否違反相關限制；這裡都沒有。

cues.en: And then it's giving us back some information about how many tokens we used in order to do this.
cues.zh: 接著是這次使用了多少 Token 的資訊。

cues.en: So we can see that it used 190 tokens for input, meaning all we see here cost 190 tokens.
cues.zh: 可以看到輸入用了 190 個 Token，也就是上面全部的內容，一共算 190 個 Token。

cues.en: We saw that it totally used an output of 536, and 212 of those were for
cues.zh: 總輸出用了 536 個，其中 212 個用於

cues.en: reasoning, because it was a reasoning model.
cues.zh: 推理，因為這是推理模型。

cues.en: So the last token, the number between these two is this part, because this is the only thing it generated.
cues.zh: 扣掉推理後的 Token，就對應這裡真正產生的內容，因為模型只生成了這一部分。

cues.en: The rest is just logging around our system.
cues.zh: 其餘則是系統周邊的記錄資訊。

cues.en: And this means that Agent Framework will receive this call and say, oh, that means the user will like to call this tool.
cues.zh: Agent Framework 收到這個回應，就知道模型希望呼叫工具，

cues.en: So they invoke this tool on our behalf, send in Paris as the city, and you can see I set a breakpoint here.
cues.zh: 因此代替我們執行工具，把 Paris 傳入 city。可以看到，我在這裡設了中斷點。

cues.en: And now we could expect that the LM sits and waits for us, and there could be some time out or something, and that's absolutely not true.
cues.zh: 你可能以為 LLM 此時會坐著等我們，甚至可能等到逾時，但完全不是這樣。

cues.en: The LM doesn't care at all what we do now.
cues.zh: LLM 不在乎我們現在做什麼，

cues.en: It doesn't wait for us.
cues.zh: 它沒有等我們，

cues.en: It doesn't think it's missing to do something.
cues.zh: 也不認為自己還有事情沒完成。

cues.en: It, in its mind, it's complete, because it told you, hey, I want to call this tool.
cues.zh: 對它來說，已經完成工作，因為它說了「我要呼叫這個工具」。

cues.en: And now it's off serving other people.
cues.zh: 接著它就去服務其他人了。

cues.en: There's no connections.
cues.zh: 中間沒有保持連線，

cues.en: There's no persistent connection.
cues.zh: 沒有持續性的連線，

cues.en: There's nothing between us and the system right now, because what happens is when we call
cues.zh: 目前我們和系統之間沒有任何這樣的關聯，因為下一次

cues.en: again, we send the entire message once again.
cues.zh: 呼叫時，會再把完整訊息送一次。

cues.en: And technically, it's an entire new thing for the LM, and it doesn't know that we called it before.
cues.zh: 技術上，這對 LLM 是一個全新的請求，它不知道我們之前呼叫過。

cues.en: So we sent the same information, speak like a pirate, user, and stuff like that, but we're sending this extra part in that, hey,
cues.zh: 所以會再送一樣的資訊，包括海盜口吻指示、使用者訊息等，但多加這段：

cues.en: you told us to call this tool, and here's the result of that tool.
cues.zh: 「你剛才要求呼叫這個工具，而這是工具的結果。」

cues.en: It's sunny and 90 degrees.
cues.zh: 結果是晴天、90 度。

cues.en: Beyond that, we sent the same two starting messages.
cues.zh: 除此之外，開頭兩則訊息相同，

cues.en: We sent the model again.
cues.zh: 再傳一次模型名稱，

cues.en: We sent the response format, which we not used in the first one.
cues.zh: 再傳回應格式；第一次其實還沒用到這個格式，

cues.en: So why did we send it?
cues.zh: 那為什麼第一次也傳呢？

cues.en: Well, it could have been that the question would just be hello, and then we would need to use it, because there was no tool call.
cues.zh: 因為問題可能只是 Hello，沒有工具呼叫，那就得直接用這個格式回答。

cues.en: We get the same prompt thing about self -aid and self-harm and so on, and
cues.zh: 同樣還有自傷等相關內容檢查資訊，

cues.en: when we sent the second request, we sent the response format exactly in the same structure as before.
cues.zh: 第二次請求中的 Response Format，和之前的結構完全相同。

cues.en: We also sent a tool again, because it could be that it needed to call the tool again.
cues.zh: 也再次傳入工具定義，因為它可能還需要再呼叫工具。

cues.en: Had the message been, what is the weather like in Paris and Berlin, it would technically send one request, call the tool, send one
cues.zh: 如果原本問的是「巴黎和柏林的天氣如何？」，就可能先送一次請求、呼叫工具，再送一次

cues.en: request, call the tool, and first there, it would have all this data.
cues.zh: 請求、再呼叫工具，之後才取得完整資料。

cues.en: So there's a lot of back and forward that we really don't see when it's abstracted away, and when we send this again, we pay for all these tokens again.
cues.zh: 所以抽象層背後有很多來回操作，我們平常看不到；而再次傳送時，這些 Token 也會再計費。

cues.en: So that is also the reason why the second we put on a tool or structured output, it will cost us more.
cues.zh: 這也是一旦加入工具或結構化輸出，費用就會增加的原因。

cues.en: It's, of course, incredibly powerful, so we shouldn't think that it's wrong to cost extra, but that's just the way it works.
cues.zh: 這些功能當然非常強大，多花費用並非不合理，只是要知道它實際如何運作。

cues.en: So this would call, had we known this up front, we could have made this call instead, and it would know, because everything is
cues.zh: 如果一開始就知道全部資料，其實可以直接送這個完整請求，因為

cues.en: here that it needs to know in order to answer the question now, and the second response comes back, and in this case, it's a finishing reason of stop, meaning it's done.
cues.zh: 回答所需的一切都在這裡。接著第二次回應回來，Finish Reason 是 stop，表示已經完成。

cues.en: It has sent us what it thinks is our final result, meaning the city equals Paris, the condition equals sunny, the degrees Fahrenheit equals
cues.zh: 它回傳自己認為的最終結果，也就是 City 為 Paris、Condition 為 Sunny、華氏溫度為

cues.en: 66, and degrees Celsius equals 19.
cues.zh: 66 度，攝氏溫度為 19 度。

cues.en: It gives again back the IDs and stuff, the self-harm part and stuff, and the
cues.zh: 同樣還有 ID、自傷檢查等資訊，以及

cues.en: final tokens being used.
cues.zh: 最後的 Token 用量。

cues.en: So the completion token is small, because it's only what we get back here, and the prompt token is bigger than the first time.
cues.zh: Completion Token 比較少，因為只產生這一小段；Prompt Token 則比第一次多。

cues.en: It was 190, now it's 227, meaning this costs the difference between 227 and 190.
cues.zh: 第一次是 190，現在是 227，多出來的費用就是 227 與 190 的差。

cues.en: And then we're done.
cues.zh: 然後就完成了。

cues.en: We can take this JSON and turn it into our object, and that's everything that is to it.
cues.zh: 把這段 JSON 轉成我們的物件，就是全部流程。

cues.en: It is completely request-response, request-response with a magic happening up with the next token
cues.zh: 它完全是一次次請求與回應，中間透過預測下一個 Token 產生看似神奇的結果，

cues.en: prediction, but beyond that, it is just a stateless machine of running.
cues.zh: 除此之外，其實就是一部無狀態的處理機器。

cues.en: It's not like it's sitting there waiting or having a hook into your machine, being able to call your tools or magically know how
cues.zh: 不是模型坐在那裡等待，或偷偷連進你的電腦呼叫工具，也不是它神奇地知道

cues.en: to run C-sharp up there.
cues.zh: 怎麼在雲端執行 C#。

cues.en: All the tools are run on your machine with your access and so on, and it's quite a brilliant system in order, in the
cues.zh: 工具都在你的電腦上，透過你的權限執行。這個設計的運作方式，

cues.en: way it works, and this is really helping a lot of people understand what is actually
cues.zh: 其實非常巧妙，也幫助很多人理解

cues.en: going on, why it is so incredible, magical, and at the same time so damn simple.
cues.zh: 為什麼它看起來如此神奇，背後卻又這麼簡單。

cues.en: So now we know the life of an Olicon, and we are ready to go on and tackle RAC.
cues.zh: 現在了解 LLM 呼叫的生命週期了，接下來準備進入 RAG。
